title: Twisted Deligne products of semisimple tensor categories
summary: We discuss the classification of twisted Deligne products of two semisimple tensor categories $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$, i.e., categorifications of the tensor product of their Grothendieck rings in which the factors are categorified by $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$. In particular, we show that if both factors have no non-trivial gradings, or if one factor has neither non-trivial gradings nor tensor structures on the identity functor, then the only twisted Deligne product is the ordinary one.
